purpose: Authorized local Qwen2.5 model-scale capacity and health research, not a strength evaluation or production deployment

conclusion.seven_b_too_small: Not established by parameter count or two short positions. 7B made a concrete known-clear voting error here; 14B is a feasible comparison candidate, not a proven stronger player.
conclusion.fourteen_b_capacity: Loaded at 16384 context with all 49 layers offloaded to Metal and no additional swap-outs during health checks. However macOS memory pressure rose from normal (1) to warning (2), so headroom is constrained.
conclusion.thirty_two_b: Metadata only; no 32B weight bytes downloaded, no load attempted. Its approximately 19.85 GB weights exceed the 12 GB additional-disk budget and current free disk. Current warning memory pressure also argues against attempting it.
conclusion.promotion: No changes to production, no strength or win-rate claim, no automatic model promotion. Independently enforce hard facts and legal actions outside any model.

server.stop_note: The existing helper checks PID start time, executable, process group, and ownership of loopback port 11437 before SIGTERM. Do not use killall or touch the default Ollama service. Stop helper was not invoked in this renewed run.
server.context_note: The unchanged helper still defaults to 4096. EVERY comparison request must explicitly send num_ctx=16384. /api/ps and both runner commands verified 16384 for these checks.
server.schema: Private reason BEFORE action_id; action_id enum restricted to current legal actions; independently validate JSON, legality, and hard facts. No tools; never execute model output.

unload_without_stopping_server.note: Use if memory needs relief; model files remain. For explicit sequential comparison, unload the old model and confirm /api/ps has no models before loading the next.

14b.format: GGUF V3; header checked; inert data only
14b.download_note: One deliberate restart after severe slowdown and one HTTP read timeout near completion; resumed with validated HTTP 206 Range, rehashed retained partial bytes, full final SHA-256 matched. No duplicate model copy.

32b_metadata_only.kv_estimate_formula: 2(K,V) * 64 layers * 8 KV heads * 128 head dimension * 2 bytes * 16384 tokens
32b_metadata_only.rough_capacity_estimate_not_measured: 18.49 GiB weights plus 4 GiB FP16 KV plus runtime/compute buffers: roughly 23-26 GiB total. A lightly loaded 64 GiB Mac could be a plausible host, but current memory warning, disk space and budget rule it out now.
32b_metadata_only.latency: Not measured; no extrapolated strength or latency claim.

health_checks.scope: Exactly two distinct short synthetic positions per model, one request each, identical 16384 context / temperature 0 / 4 threads / seed 1013 / 128 output limit. These are action guard checks, not games or strength estimates.
health_checks.known_wolf_expected: Private SEER result says Player2 is a wolf; legal vote 2 required.
health_checks.known_clear_expected: Final three include own SEER seat0 and engine-confirmed villager Player2; one wolf remains, so vote Player1 (action 1), never the confirmed clear.

7b.known_clear_failure: The reason explicitly acknowledged Player2 is a confirmed villager, yet action_id selected Player2. A valid JSON enum did not prevent a losing hard-fact violation.

14b.reason_factuality_caveat: The known-wolf reason mentions Player3's false accusation, although the prompt instead says Player2 accused Player3 and Player3 agreed to vote Player2. Correct action is not proof of a factually faithful reason.

health_checks.timing_caveat: Very short prompts, different output lengths, one sample each; no full-16384-token workload or tail-latency test. Separate initial server GPU discovery waited about 30 seconds before requests. Do not compare these numbers directly to older 4096-context runs.

resources_and_safety.memory_note: macOS memory_pressure's free percentage is not literal unused physical RAM. Physical free pages were low, and compression increased materially. No new swap-outs in this short test does not establish safety for a prolonged workload.
resources_and_safety.health_emergency_stop_thresholds: critical pressure >=4, >1024 MiB additional swap used, or disk free <1.5 GiB; none triggered
resources_and_safety.parent_action: Keep comparisons strictly sequential and monitor memory pressure, swap-out growth and disk. Do not try 32B now. If pressure becomes critical or swapping accelerates, unload this research model or use its verified stop helper; do not change OS security or other services.

isolation_and_integrity.inference_network: Existing unchanged sandbox allows only loopback and denies Internet/LAN/DNS; public downloads used separate local research helpers, not the inference process.
isolation_and_integrity.runtime_changes_authorized: Existing helper updated server_state.json for new PID and appended server.log; added only verified 14B manifest/config/weights in the dedicated temporary models directory.

sources_and_artifacts.tag_note: The official URL returned a JSON tags list under the helper's Accept header. Exact case-sensitive 14b-instruct-q4_K_M and 32b-instruct-q4_K_M tags were discovered before manifest fetching; not assumed.
sources_and_artifacts.known_runtime_issue: The existing Ollama GPU-discovery watchdog again timed out at startup and initially described CPU. Subsequent inference logs selected MTL0, offloaded every layer, and /api/ps reported Metal residency; initial discovery warning was not inference failure.
